name: Adriaen Kocks
bio: Delft potter who owned the pottery De Grieksche A from 1687. His workshop made the large flower pyramids and tiles for Queen Mary II and King William III.

milestones.event: Became the owner of the pottery De Grieksche A in Delft.
Made flower pyramids and tiles for the dairy and the water gallery of Queen Mary II at Hampton Court.
Made tiles for the dairy of Queen Mary II at Hampton Court.
